sn42.1:1.2: atha kho caṇḍo gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho caṇḍo gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.1:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco caṇḍo caṇḍotve saṅkhaṃ gacchati
sn42.1:1.4: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco sorato soratotve saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
sn42.1:1.5: idha gāmaṇi ekaccassa rāgo appahīno hoti
sn42.1:1.6: rāgassa appahīnattā pare kopenti parehi kopiyamāno kopaṃ pātukaroti
sn42.1:1.9: dosassa appahīnattā pare kopenti parehi kopiyamāno kopaṃ pātukaroti
sn42.1:1.12: mohassa appahīnattā pare kopenti parehi kopiyamāno kopaṃ pātukaroti
sn42.1:1.14: ayaṃ kho gāmaṇi hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacco caṇḍo caṇḍotve saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn42.1:2.1: idha pana gāmaṇi ekaccassa rāgo pahīno hoti
sn42.1:2.2: rāgassa pahīnattā pare na kopenti parehi kopiyamāno kopaṃ na pātukaroti
sn42.1:2.5: dosassa pahīnattā pare na kopenti parehi kopiyamāno kopaṃ na pātukaroti
sn42.1:2.8: mohassa pahīnattā pare na kopenti parehi kopiyamāno kopaṃ na pātukaroti
sn42.1:2.10: ayaṃ kho gāmaṇi hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacco sorato soratotve saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
sn42.1:3.1: evaṃ vutte caṇḍo gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.1:3.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
sn42.1:3.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn42.1:3.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
